title: JWT audience validation globally disabled in shared library - cross-audience token replay
owner_hint: no CODEOWNERS entry; top committer: Michael Stonis; component: eShop.ServiceDefaults/
rationale: Deletes the single line ValidateAudience = false, restoring the JwtBearer default so the per-service options.Audience (orders/basket/webhooks) becomes effective — aud-arrays are validated by intersection, so the WebApp-relayed multi-audience token still works by design while swagger single-audience tokens no longer cross services. Matches the maintainer's unmerged 'Re-enable audience validation' commit.
variants_checked: ValidateAudience appears exactly once in source; no custom AudienceValidator or ValidAudiences override; consumers confirmed (Ordering/Basket/Webhooks Extensions).
bypass_considered: Basket-audience token replayed at Ordering.API is now 401; residual: multi-audience user tokens pass all three services by design — scope/policy enforcement is the intended boundary.
test_note: Omitted — tests/ contains no ServiceDefaults test project.
review_reason: Minimal one-line deletion at the exact cited line; re-enables rather than removes a check; correct layer (shared baseline).
